title: 第5章 女魔头再见宁尘名字第6章 藏经阁八百贡献点惊众人
slug: 魔门送葬开局被女帝逆推
lines: “这样一来，外界对你们的认识也会增多，有得也有失。”
陈昊没有再说更多，然而若男和洁雯心中都如明镜般，明白了大致的情况。
成为便利店的代言人意味着公开她们与陈昊的关系，这会给她们带来更多关注和支持，当然也可能引起部分人的敌意。
当初选择追随陈昊时，她们就已经预料到了这一点。
每个人的选择都伴随着利弊，关键是衡量哪一方更为重要。
目前来看，显然好处大于风险，因为陈昊已经表示要让她们担任便利店的广告宣传任务。
见时间不早了，而两位姑娘因按摩几乎手臂酸痛。
陈昊轻挥手示意结束，说道：
“今天就到这里吧，你们回去休息，明天去嘉尚班人力资源公司找我。”
“走时记得在吧台找到阿亮拿酒。”
这次洁雯没有反对，她向若男道歉，然后离开了陈昊的办公室
若男有些失望地想着今晚没能发生什么超越朋友关系的事情，尽管陈昊曾保证不会违背意愿做任何事，可是她根本连表达心声的机会也没有。
不过，若男暗暗心想，机会总是会来的，且走且看吧。
随后她们一起走出办公室，找到了吧台上的酒保阿亮，听他说起了有关陈昊的一些事情。
作为新任老板的贴心员工，了解上司的偏好自然是职责所在，尤其是便利店的相关信息，包括洪兴成员将享受五折优惠的消息。
听到这个，若男和洁雯惊讶得说不出话来，如此大方之举实在罕见，似乎陈昊真的是出手阔绰的人。
若男抱着洁雯忧虑道：“老板这样太浪费了，明天我们一起去劝劝他吧！”
洁雯也深以为然。
接着，阿亮恭敬地递上了两瓶由浩哥打包好的拉菲红酒，亲切称呼二人为大嫂。
洁雯听到后微微脸红，并未反驳，而接过了红酒；相反，若男却笑着夸奖阿亮点名有眼力见儿。
“真机灵，你这孩子。”
她笑着附和，阿亮点头哈腰，“两位大嫂慢走。”
小弟们纷纷附和着喊。
被“大嫂”
的称呼包围中，二人仿佛置身云端，步履也变得轻快无比，像是自由飞翔的精灵。
当看到她们拿着拉菲酒离去时，阿亮露出满意的微笑。
为了促成此事并传播陈昊便利店的信息，他刻意把这对新人的消息散布出去——身为大哥的女人，在兄弟口中，称一声嫂子是自然之事。
让大哥女人管理自己的行为岂不是两全其美？他们不想看到大哥的钱就这样无端耗费。
离开酒吧的时候，洁雯低声道：
“这样是不是不好，要是老板生气了怎么办？”
content_en:
"In this way, the outside world will know more about you, which will bring you both gains and losses."
Chen Hao didn't say anything more, but Ruonan and Jiewen both understood the general situation like a mirror in their hearts.
Becoming the spokesperson of a convenience store means making their relationship with Chen Hao public, which will bring them more attention and support, but may also arouse hostility from some people.
They had already anticipated this when they chose to follow Chen Hao.
Each choice comes with pros and cons, and the key is to weigh which one is more important.
At present, it is obvious that the benefits outweigh the risks, because Chen Hao has already stated that he will let them serve as advertising tasks for convenience stores.
It was getting late, and the two girls' arms were almost sore from the massage.
Chen Hao waved his hand gently to signal the end and said:
"That's it for today. You go back and rest. Find me at Jiashangban Human Resources Company tomorrow."
"When you leave, remember to find A Liang at the bar to get a drink."
This time Jiewen didn't object. She apologized to Ruonan and left Chen Hao's office.
??
Ruonan was a little disappointed, thinking that nothing more than a friendship could happen tonight. Although Chen Hao had promised that he would not do anything against his will, she did not even have a chance to express her feelings.
However, Ruonan secretly thought to himself, opportunities will always come, just wait and see.
Then they walked out of the office together and found the bartender A Liang at the bar, listening to him talk about something about Chen Hao.
As a caring employee of the new boss, it is naturally his duty to understand his boss's preferences, especially information about convenience stores, including the news that Hongxing members will enjoy a 50% discount.
Hearing this, Ruonan and Jiewen were so surprised that they were speechless. Such a generous move was really rare. It seemed that Chen Hao was really a generous person.
Ruonan hugged Jiewen and said worriedly: "The boss is so wasteful. Let's go and persuade him tomorrow!"
Jiewen also agreed.
Then, A Liang respectfully handed over two bottles of Lafite red wine packed by Brother Hao, and affectionately called the two of them sister-in-law.
Jiewen blushed slightly after hearing this and took the red wine without retorting. On the contrary, Ruonan smiled and praised Ah Liang for his reputation as a discerning man.
"So clever, you kid."
She agreed with a smile, and Ah Liang nodded and bowed, "Sister-in-law, please walk slowly."
The younger brothers all shouted in agreement.
Being "sister-in-law"
Surrounded by their names, the two of them seemed to be in the clouds, and their steps became extremely brisk, like elves flying freely.
When he saw them leaving with Lafite wine, A Liang showed a satisfied smile.
In order to promote this matter and spread the information about Chen Hao's convenience store, he deliberately spread the news about the new couple - as the eldest brother, it is natural for the woman to call her sister-in-law among the brothers.
Wouldn’t it be the best of both worlds to let older women manage their own behavior? They don't want to see their eldest brother's money being wasted for no reason.
When leaving the bar, Jiewen whispered:
"Isn't this bad? What if the boss gets angry?"
